headline.momentum: K-beauty is accelerating its India entry to offset SWANA-region volatility (Personal Care Insights, Apr 2026). 2026 launches: APR's Medicube (Nykaa + Tira), AmorePacific's Illiyoon (Nykaa exclusive), TirTir (Nykaa, Jun 2026), Tira's Hince (Jan) and Dr. Melaxin (Jul). India K-beauty ~INR 3,139cr (2025) forecast ~26% CAGR to ~INR 32,424cr by 2035 (Expert Market Research). AmorePacific is scaling India via platforms/imports, NOT local manufacturing — no India plant announced.
